menu_path_issues: The 'add a subscription (mobile)' path is incomplete and the methods are not a navigation path (see refuted). The '+' > Manual Input > Done path exists in both EN and RU docs.

Apple TV path: 'Local network import' is the first-listed option and 'Web Import' is the fallback. The RU page says Web Import is for when the local network is unavailable. The EN heading is 'Import via local network' (RU 'Импорт по локальной сети').
RU Android TV path was marked 'RU page not read' but is available. It matches the EN steps and keeps 'Web Import' in Latin.
The docs show the main screen 'Settings' only inside paths. The settings icon or tab location is not documented, and platform differences (mobile vs desktop vs TV) are not stated.
'Check Current Connection': the docs do not state that it appears only when connected, so state=connected is unverified.
'Share' states 'both' (connected and disconnected), but the docs do not say so. They also describe a swipe gesture, so the flow is mobile only.
The task cited no source for the Android 4.10.1 and desktop 4.8.1 labels. The docs do not tie their wording to those builds, and the labels may differ in the actual apps.
missing_flows: connect/disconnect: connect button and connected-state labels are not in the table
update subscription: manual refresh and the pull-to-refresh/update icon; only the 9 s timeout error is mentioned
server choice: selecting a server or configuration, and the auto/best-ping option
system proxy / TUN toggle on desktop
language setting: where the language is switched. The user asked to check the Russian UI, so the app's real RU locale strings are still unchecked.

other error messages in the docs without labels: 'Configuration {config type} is not valid', 'JSON (or array) configuration is not valid', 'Invalid deeplink URL', 'Unknown content type', 'Wrong data for import routing profile'. RU texts were not read for these.
Apple TV local-network import (RU 'Импорт по локальной сети') and the tv.happ.su 'Send' (RU 'Отправить') button, as a separate import path
no verification against the real apps: RU strings in the actual app, as opposed to the docs, are unchecked. Examples: 'Буффер' typo, 'Ping' kept Latin, 'Timeout'.
caveats: Happ is CLOSED SOURCE. github.com/Happ-proxy/happ-android, happ-desktop and happ-ios hold only a README and release binaries (happ-ios has no releases). No source, no locale files, no key names: nothing was verified in code. Every label comes from the official happ.su docs, a secondary source, summarized by an LLM fetch tool, so quotes may be imperfect.

No verified labels for: connect/disconnect button and its connected/disconnected states, proxy mode (Rule/Global/Direct), update one/all subscriptions, add by URL or file, system proxy and TUN toggles, language setting, logs/diagnostics, traffic/speed counters while connected. The assistant must not name any button for these.
ru_locale_present=true is inferred only because happ.su Russian docs quote Russian UI labels. The app's own Russian locale files were not seen. The doc label 'Диплинк' may not match the in-app text.

Gesture and icon descriptions (swipe, speedometer) are mobile-layout; desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux) layout was not verified. RU texts for error messages and Web Import were not obtained (RU Apple TV/Android TV pages failed to load).
